reuse.why: All providers share the new link guard and existing bank lookup and sync helpers, but Fintegra copies provider workflows and takeover duplicates local unlink cleanup.

duplication.why: The diff adds three substantial duplicated blocks: the Fintegra linking workflow, its transaction downloader, and the account fields cleared during unlinking.

placement.why: Provider handlers, downloads, configuration and models follow existing module boundaries, although account mutation is hidden inside an assertion helper.

scope.why: The changes remain focused on the four requested linking and provider enhancements.

maintainability.why: Centralized link rules help maintenance, but copied provider workflows and an assertion that also unlinks accounts create avoidable ownership and evolution costs.

bypasses_abstraction.where: assertBankAccountNotLinked duplicates the local cleanup owned by unlinkAccount instead of extracting that operation for both paths to share while keeping provider disconnection separate.

disguised_duplication.where: The duplicated linking, downloading and unlink cleanup blocks remain recognizable copies rather than being disguised through restructuring.

abstraction_drift.where: assertBankAccountNotLinked gains replaceExistingLink, closed-target validation and conditional takeover behavior, evolving from a duplicate-link assertion into a mutating operation; all six provider link handlers call it.
